item.title: How to Host Static Files on a CDN with Casdoor: S3, MinIO, Azure Blob and Other Storage Providers
item.description: Where Casdoor keeps avatars and uploaded files (local disk, Amazon S3, MinIO, Azure Blob, GCS, OSS, COS, Synology) and how to serve them through a CDN.
item.content:encoded:
To host static files on a CDN, put them in object storage (Amazon S3, MinIO, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage, Alibaba Cloud OSS or Tencent Cloud COS), make the CDN pull from that bucket as its origin, and hand out URLs on the CDN's domain. In Casdoor this is one setting: create a storage provider for the bucket and put the CDN address in its Domain field. Casdoor uploads avatars and other files through the provider's API and saves URLs that start with that domain. Casdoor's own frontend can come from a CDN as well, through frontendCdnUrl and staticBaseUrl in app.conf.

Storage providers at a glance​

A storage provider decides where Casdoor writes uploaded files: user avatars, ID card images, terms-of-use pages, and anything uploaded on the Resources page. You add the provider to an application, and uploads made in that application go to it. The storage provider overview lists all the types. This table covers the ones people usually ask about:

StorageCasdoor provider typeDoes Casdoor use the S3 API?Self-hostableHow the public URL is set
Local file systemLocal File SystemNo, plain files on diskYes, it is the Casdoor serverServed by Casdoor under /files/. Domain is read-only
Amazon S3AWS S3YesNoDomain: the bucket URL or a CloudFront domain. Endpoint (Intranet): a VPC endpoint
MinIOMinIOYes, with path-style requestsYesDomain: the MinIO URL followed by the bucket name, or a CDN domain
Alibaba Cloud OSSAliyun OSSNo, the OSS SDKNoDomain: a CDN domain. Left empty, it becomes bucket.endpoint. Endpoint (Intranet): the internal endpoint
Tencent Cloud COSTencent Cloud COSNo, the COS APINoDomain: a CDN domain
Azure Blob StorageAzure BlobNo, the Blob APINoDomain: a custom or Front Door domain. Casdoor adds the container name to the path
Google Cloud StorageGoogle Cloud StorageNo, Google's Go clientNoDomain: left empty, it becomes https://storage.googleapis.com. Casdoor adds the bucket name to the path
Synology NASSynologyNo, the DSM File Station APIYesNo Domain field. The URL is based on Endpoint

Casdoor also supports Qiniu Cloud Kodo, CUCloud OSS, and Casdoor, which stores files in another Casdoor instance. The per-provider guides for Amazon S3, MinIO, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS, Synology NAS and the local file system show which value goes in which field.

Endpoint vs. Domain​

These two fields do different jobs, and most CDN problems come from mixing them up.

  • Endpoint is the address Casdoor uses to talk to the storage API: upload, delete, list. The CDN is not involved.
  • Endpoint (Intranet) replaces Endpoint when isCloudIntranet = true is set in app.conf. That keeps upload traffic on the provider's internal network when Casdoor runs in the same cloud. The field appears for AWS S3, Aliyun OSS, Azure Blob and CUCloud OSS.
  • Domain is the base of the URL that Casdoor saves and that browsers request. If you have a CDN, its domain goes here.
  • Path prefix is put in front of every object key. With a prefix of casdoor, an avatar ends up under casdoor/avatar/....

Casdoor builds the file URL from the scheme and host of Domain, then the path of Domain, then the path prefix, then the file path. A Domain without a scheme gets https://. The path part of Domain also becomes part of the object key, so https://cdn.example.com/casdoor/ stores files under casdoor/ in the bucket. For Azure Blob and Google Cloud Storage, Casdoor adds the container or bucket name as the first path segment after the host. Your CDN needs to serve that path.

If Domain is empty, Casdoor fills it in from the provider's endpoint the first time it uses the provider, and saves it. Sometimes the result works, as with OSS and GCS. Sometimes it doesn't: for an S3 endpoint without the bucket name, or for MinIO, where path-style requests put the bucket name in the path, the generated URL misses the bucket. Set Domain yourself, upload one test avatar, and open the URL Casdoor returns before anyone else uses it.

The provider that Casdoor uses for avatars it copies from social logins comes from defaultStorageProvider in app.conf. It is the name of a provider owned by admin (see the configuration reference):

defaultStorageProvider = provider_storage_s3
isCloudIntranet = false

Public buckets, private buckets and signed URLs​

Casdoor saves one plain, permanent URL in the user's avatar field and in the resource record. It doesn't create signed or expiring URLs for these files. So whatever is at Domain has to answer an anonymous GET. There are two ways to do that.

Make the objects public. With AWS S3 and MinIO, Casdoor uploads every object with the public-read canned ACL. With Aliyun OSS, the client library does the same by default. On S3 this conflicts with the defaults for new buckets: according to AWS, new buckets use the Bucket owner enforced setting, which disables ACLs, and an upload that sets an ACL such as public-read fails with AccessControlListNotSupported. That is why the Amazon S3 guide has you turn on ACLs and turn off Block all public access. On OSS, an object ACL takes precedence over the bucket ACL, so a public-read object can be read even in a private bucket. MinIO doesn't use the ACL for anonymous reads. It uses a bucket policy:

mc anonymous set download myminio/casdoor

Azure needs anonymous access allowed on the storage account and the container set to the Blob access level. Google Cloud Storage needs the Storage Object Viewer role (roles/storage.objectViewer) granted to allUsers on the bucket.

Keep the bucket private and let only the CDN read it. The CDN signs its requests to the origin, and viewers go through the CDN without a signature. Each vendor has its own version:

  • CloudFront has origin access control (OAC). AWS requires Bucket owner enforced for OAC, or Bucket owner preferred if you need ACLs.
  • Alibaba Cloud CDN can fetch from a private OSS bucket after you authorize it.
  • Tencent Cloud CDN has origin-pull authentication for private COS buckets.
  • Azure Front Door Premium can reach a storage account over Private Link.
  • Google's Cloud CDN guide covers private bucket access too, where the Storage Object Viewer role goes to a service account instead of allUsers.

This hides the bucket's own URL, but the files are still public through the CDN. With the AWS S3 and Aliyun OSS types, the objects also stay readable at their bucket URLs, because of the public-read ACL that Casdoor sets.

If avatars must not be public at all, a CDN in front of object storage is the wrong tool. Keep those files on a storage type you control, and limit who can reach that host.

Cache headers and the avatar trap​

On S3 and MinIO, Casdoor sets Content-Type from the file extension when it uploads. It doesn't set Cache-Control on any provider. That means the CDN's default TTL applies. On CloudFront, objects without Cache-Control are cached for the default TTL, which is 24 hours when you don't use a cache policy. To control this per object, add Cache-Control metadata in the bucket. For a whole path, use a cache rule on the CDN.

Avatars need a short TTL. When a user changes their picture, Casdoor writes the new file to the same key, avatar/<organization>/<username>.<extension>, and saves the same URL. A long TTL means people see the old picture until it expires or until you purge or invalidate that path. Other uploads get a numbered suffix (-1, -2, ...) when the name is already taken, so a new upload gets a new URL and can be cached for a long time.

A layout that works:

PathSuggested caching
avatar/*Short TTL (minutes), or purge on change
resource/* and other uploadsLong TTL
Hashed frontend assets (assets/*)Very long TTL. The file name changes on every build

Casdoor's own frontend on a CDN​

Separate from user uploads, there are three ways to move Casdoor's own static files off the Casdoor server.

frontendCdnUrl. Use this if you install the frontend from the casdoor-web npm package. Point it at an npm CDN, for example:

frontendCdnUrl = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/{name}@{version}"

Casdoor reads the package name and version from the package.json in the build folder. It rewrites the script and stylesheet links in index.html to that CDN and keeps the local paths as a fallback. If a file fails to load, the browser loads it from Casdoor, and a cookie keeps that browser on local files for the rest of the session. A frontend you build yourself has no such package.json, so the setting has no effect on it.

The deployment script. For a frontend you build from source, Host the frontend files on a CDN explains deployment/deploy_test.go. It uploads web/build/assets/ through one of your storage providers and points index.html at the provider's Domain, which must end with /. Vite hashes these file names, so they suit the long TTL in the table above.

staticBaseUrl. This sets where default images such as logos, provider icons and the default avatar come from. The default is https://cdn.casbin.org, which serves the casbin/static repository. On a network without internet access, serve a copy of that repository yourself and point staticBaseUrl at it, as described in Host static files on an intranet.

Picking one​

  • One server, small user base: Local File System. Mount the files directory on a volume if Casdoor runs in a container. Casdoor sends X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and a sandboxing Content-Security-Policy with these files, so an uploaded HTML or SVG file can't run script on your Casdoor domain.
  • Self-hosted and S3-shaped: MinIO. It is also the type the docs suggest for other S3-compatible stores.
  • Already on a cloud: use that cloud's object storage and CDN, set Endpoint (Intranet) where Casdoor runs in the same cloud, and set Domain to the CDN.

参考资料​

  • Casdoor storage providers and the source: object/storage.go, storage/, routers/frontend_cdn.go
  • AWS: Controlling ownership of objects and disabling ACLs, Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin, Manage how long content stays in the cache
  • MinIO: mc anonymous set
  • Microsoft: Configure anonymous read access for containers and blobs, Integrate an Azure Storage account with Azure Front Door
  • Google Cloud: Making data public, Set up Cloud CDN with a backend bucket
  • Alibaba Cloud: Object ACL, Origin fetch from private OSS buckets
  • Tencent Cloud: Setting CDN Acceleration for COS

item.title: MailHog vs Mailpit：使用 Casdoor 测试验证和密码重置邮件
item.description: MailHog 和 Mailpit 都监听 SMTP 端口 1025 和 Web UI 端口 8025。比较维护情况、Docker 镜像和测试 API，然后将 Casdoor 指向其中之一。
item.content:encoded:
MailHog 和 Mailpit 都是用于开发的伪 SMTP 服务器：它们接受每条消息，保留它，并在 Web UI 中显示而不是投递它。两者都使用相同的默认端口，SMTP 为 1025，Web UI 和 API 为 8025，因此对于任何一个，SMTP 地址都是 smtp://127.0.0.1:1025，收件箱位于 http://127.0.0.1:8025。区别在于维护情况：MailHog 的最后一次发布 v1.0.1 发布于 2020 年 8 月，而 Mailpit 于 2026 年 10 月 31 日发布了 v1.33.0。对于新项目，请使用 Mailpit。Casdoor 通过普通的 SMTP 提供商向两者发送消息，因此您可以在没有真实邮件账户的情况下测试注册代码、密码重置邮件和魔法链接。

MailHog vs Mailpit 概览​

MailHogMailpit
最新发布版v1.0.1, 2020-08-11v1.33.0, 2026-10-31
默认分支上的最后一次提交2022-08-022026-10-31
LicenseMITMIT
Default SMTP port10251025
Default web UI and API port80258025
Docker imagemailhog/mailhog, amd64 onlyaxllent/mailpit, amd64, arm64 and 386
HTTP APIv1 and v2: list, get, delete, search by from, to or containingv1: list, get, delete, search with filters such as to: and subject:, latest message shortcut
Default storageIn memoryTemporary SQLite database, deleted on exit
Persistent storageMongoDB or MaildirSQLite file (MP_DATABASE) or rqlite
Message limitNone documentedKeeps the newest 500 by default (MP_MAX_MESSAGES)
HTML check, link check, spam checkNoYes
Webhook on new mailNoYes (MP_WEBHOOK_URL)
SMTP TLSNot offeredOptional STARTTLS or SSL/TLS
Failure injectionJimChaos
Release a message to a real SMTP serverYesYes
POP3 serverNoYes, optional
Basic auth for the web UIYesYes

Docker Hub counts show that many people still pull MailHog. That reflects old tutorials and CI files, not activity: an open issue on the MailHog repository titled "THIS PROJECT IS DEAD!" has a 2023 reply from the author saying he no longer has time to maintain it. Mailpit's README describes itself as inspired by MailHog and points to that same comment.

The image architecture matters more than it looks. On an Apple Silicon laptop or an ARM CI runner, mailhog/mailhog runs only under emulation, while axllent/mailpit has a native arm64 image.

使用 Docker 运行任一工具​

MailHog:

docker run -d --name mailhog -p 1025:1025 -p 8025:8025 mailhog/mailhog

Mailpit:

docker run -d --name mailpit -p 1025:1025 -p 8025:8025 axllent/mailpit

Mailpit 将邮件保存在临时数据库中，容器停止时数据即消失。若要在重启后保留数据，请挂载卷并设置 MP_DATABASE：

docker run -d --name mailpit \
  -v "$PWD/mailpit-data:/data" \
  -e MP_DATABASE=/data/mailpit.db \
  -p 1025:1025 -p 8025:8025 \
  axllent/mailpit

如果不使用 Docker，在 macOS 上 brew install mailhog 和 brew install mailpit 均可正常工作，且 Mailpit 在其发布页面提供了适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 的静态二进制文件。

在 GitHub Actions 中，将其作为服务容器与你的测试任务一起运行：

services:
  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit
    ports:
      - 1025:1025
      - 8025:8025

配置 Casdoor 以连接 MailHog 或 Mailpit​

Casdoor 没有专门针对 MailHog 或 Mailpit 的提供商类型，也不需要。Default 电子邮件类型通过 SMTP 发送邮件，而这两个工具都是 SMTP 服务器。

  1. 作为全局管理员，在 admin 或 built-in 组织中添加一个提供商。
  2. 将 Category 设置为 Email，将 Type 设置为 Default。
  3. 将 Host 设置为该工具运行的地址，并将 Port 设置为 1025。
  4. Username 和 Password 留空。
  5. 点击 Test SMTP Connection，然后点击 Send Testing Email，并在端口 8025 上检查 Web UI。

包含截图的分步指南页面为 Test email with MailHog 和 Test email with Mailpit。

以下细节决定了这是否能一次性成功：

保持 SSL 模式为 Auto，或者将其设置为 Disable。 在 Auto 模式下，Casdoor 仅在端口 465 上使用隐式 TLS，并且仅当服务器提供时才使用 STARTTLS 进行升级。MailHog 和默认配置的 Mailpit 都不在端口 1025 上提供 STARTTLS，因此连接保持明文状态。不要选择 Enable：这会强制使用隐式 TLS，导致握手在与明文服务器通信时失败。完整的SSL 模式表描述了具体行为。

凭证留空。 仅当设置了 Username 时，Casdoor 才会登录到 SMTP 服务器。如果你填写了它，除非主机是 localhost，否则 Go 的 PLAIN 身份验证会拒绝在未加密的连接上发送密码，因此位于 192.168.x.x 的 MailHog 即使接受任何登录也会因身份验证错误而失败。Mailpit 默认根本不要求身份验证。

使用正确的主机。 只有当 Casdoor 和邮件捕获器在同一台机器上运行时，127.0.0.1 才有效。如果两者都在 Docker Compose 中运行，请使用服务名称（例如 mailpit）作为主机。

使用全局提供商。 普通组织拥有的提供商可能只能访问互联网地址，因此无法连接到 127.0.0.1 或私有 IP。admin 或 built-in 中的提供商不受此限制。请参阅 提供商可以访问哪些地址。

为链接设置 origin。 验证码可以立即工作。密码重置链接和魔术链接需要 Casdoor 知道其公共 URL，可以通过 conf/app.conf 中的 origin 或在回环主机上的请求来实现。否则，重置链接将从电子邮件中被丢弃，且魔术链接将失败。请参阅 模板。

最后，在 向应用添加提供商 中将提供商添加到你的应用，以便注册和密码重置真正使用它。

在自动化测试中读取验证码​

Casdoor 的验证码是六位数字，默认模板显示 "Here is your code: " 后跟验证码。端到端测试会注册一个用户，要求 Casdoor 发送验证码，然后从邮件捕获器的 API 读取它。

对于 Mailpit，按收件人搜索并打开最新的匹配项。GET /api/v1/search 返回按最新顺序排列的匹配项，GET /api/v1/message/{ID} 返回解析后的 Text 和 HTML 正文：

import { request } from "@playwright/test";

const MAILPIT = process.env.MAILPIT_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:8025";

export async function latestCode(to: string): Promise<string> {
  const api = await request.newContext({ baseURL: MAILPIT });
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const res = await api.get("/api/v1/search", {
      params: { query: `to:"${to}"`, limit: "1" },
    });
    const { messages } = await res.json();
    if (messages.length > 0) {
      const msg = await (await api.get(`/api/v1/message/${messages[0].ID}`)).json();
      const match = (msg.Text || msg.HTML).match(/code: (\d{6})/);
      if (match) return match[1];
    }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
  }
  throw new Error(`no verification email for ${to}`);
}

如果每次只有一个测试发送邮件，GET /api/v1/message/latest 会跳过搜索步骤。在每个测试之前，使用不带请求体的 DELETE /api/v1/messages 来清空收件箱。

对于 MailHog，最接近的调用是 GET /api/v2/search?kind=to&query=<address>。消息在 items 中按最新优先顺序返回，正文位于 items[0].Content.Body：

const res = await api.get("/api/v2/search", {
  params: { kind: "to", query: to, limit: "1" },
});
const { items } = await res.json();
const body: string = items[0]?.Content.Body ?? "";

Content.Body 是原始的 MIME 正文。Casdoor 发送的是 quoted-printable 编码，因此 = 会变成 =3D，长行会在末尾以 = 结束进行软换行。请先解码它，或者将代码保持在短模板的开头附近。使用 DELETE /api/v1/messages 清除 MailHog 中的邮件。

从 MailHog 迁移到 Mailpit​

由于端口匹配，大多数迁移只需在 docker-compose.yml 中进行一行更改：将 mailhog/mailhog 替换为 axllent/mailpit。Casdoor 的提供商保持相同的主机和端口。发生变化的内容包括：

  • 设置。 MailHog 读取 MH_* 变量；Mailpit 读取 MP_*。如果你使用了 MH_STORAGE=maildir 或 MongoDB，请改用 MP_DATABASE。
  • 测试辅助函数。 Mailpit 没有 /api/v2 端点。将对 /api/v2/messages 和 /api/v2/search 的调用重写为 /api/v1/messages 和 /api/v1/search，并读取 messages[].ID 以及 Text 或 HTML，而不是 items[].Content.Body。quoted-printable 解码不再需要。
  • 搜索语法。 kind=to&query=a@example.com 变为 query=to:"a@example.com"。
  • 故障注入。 Jim 在 Mailpit 中没有标志位；请使用 Chaos。
  • 身份验证。 如果某个应用坚持通过明文 SMTP 登录，请使用 MP_SMTP_AUTH_ACCEPT_ANY=1 和 MP_SMTP_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 启动 Mailpit。对于 Casdoor，留空凭据更简单。
  • 保留策略。 Mailpit 默认修剪至最新的 500 条消息。如果长时间运行的测试需要更多空间，请提高 MP_MAX_MESSAGES。

转向生产环境​

除非手动释放消息，否则 MailHog 和 Mailpit 永远不会将邮件投递到真实收件箱，因此生产环境需要一个真实的提供商。在 Casdoor 中，你更换的是提供商，而不是模板。电子邮件模板、%s 代码占位符和 <reset-link> 块保持不变：

  • 任何类型为 Default 的 SMTP 服务器，详见 Email providers
  • SendGrid 和 Resend，通过其 API
  • Brevo，通过其 SMTP 中继
  • Azure Communication Services
  • 你自己的 HTTP 端点，配合 Custom HTTP Email

常见的设置是在开发和 CI 环境中保留 Mailpit，在生产环境中使用真实提供商。每个环境将其应用指向不同的提供商，因此你测试的注册流程就是即将发布的流程。

参考资料​

  • MailHog 仓库和 README：https://github.com/mailhog/MailHog
  • MailHog 配置和 API v1/v2 文档：https://github.com/mailhog/MailHog/tree/master/docs
  • MailHog 维护评论：https://github.com/mailhog/MailHog/issues/442#issuecomment-1493415258
  • Mailpit 仓库和 README：https://github.com/axllent/mailpit
  • Mailpit 文档（Docker、存储、SMTP、webhook、搜索过滤器）：https://mailpit.axllent.org/docs/
  • Mailpit API v1 参考：https://mailpit.axllent.org/docs/api-v1/
  • Casdoor 电子邮件提供商代码：https://github.com/casdoor/casdoor/tree/master/email

item.title: Cursor、Claude 和 ChatGPT 的 MCP OAuth 重定向 URI：在 Casdoor 中注册 MCP 客户端
item.description: Cursor、Claude 和 ChatGPT 用于 MCP 服务器的 OAuth 回调 URL，claude_desktop_config.json 所在的位置，以及如何在 Casdoor 中注册每个客户端。
item.content:encoded:
每个 MCP 客户端在登录受 OAuth 保护的 MCP 服务器时都会发送自己的重定向 URI。Cursor 桌面版使用 http://localhost:8787/callback（2026 年中之前的版本使用 cursor://anysphere.cursor-mcp/oauth/callback），Cursor 网页版和 Cursor Cloud Agents 使用 https://www.cursor.com/agents/mcp/oauth/callback，claude.ai、Claude Desktop 连接器、Claude 移动版和 Cowork 使用 https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback，而 ChatGPT 使用 https://chatgpt.com/connector_platform_oauth_redirect 或每个连接对应的 https://chatgpt.com/connector/oauth/<callback-id>。如果你在 Casdoor 中启用了动态客户端注册，则无需输入这些值：客户端会自行注册或将客户端 ID 元数据文档交给 Casdoor。只有当你手动为客户端创建 Casdoor 应用 时，才需要将它们添加到 Redirect URLs 中。

按客户端划分的重定向 URI​

客户端重定向 URI如何从 Casdoor 获取客户端 ID备注
Cursor 桌面版（当前）http://localhost:8787/callbackDCR，或 mcp.json 中的 auth.CLIENT_ID固定端口 8787
Cursor 网页版和 Cloud Agentshttps://www.cursor.com/agents/mcp/oauth/callbackDCR，或 auth.CLIENT_ID使用 DCR 时，桌面应用会注册此 URI 和 localhost URI
Cursor 桌面版（旧版本）cursor://anysphere.cursor-mcp/oauth/callbackDCR，或 auth.CLIENT_IDCursor 于 2026 年 7 月将环回 URI 设为默认值
claude.ai、Claude Desktop 连接器、Claude 移动版、Coworkhttps://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callbackCIMD，然后是 DCR，或在自定义连接器对话框中输入客户端 ID由 Anthropic 的服务器发起请求
Claude Codehttp://localhost:<port>/callback 和 http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callbackCIMD端口随会话变化
通过 mcp-remote 使用的 Claude Desktophttp://localhost:<port>/oauth/callbackDCR端口由服务器 URL 推导得出
ChatGPThttps://chatgpt.com/connector_platform_oauth_redirect，或 https://chatgpt.com/connector/oauth/<callback-id>CIMD、DCR，或预定义客户端从 ChatGPT 复制确切的值

这些值来自截至 2026 年 11 月 2 日的供应商文档（参见 References）。客户端可能会更改它们。当登录失败时，请在浏览器地址栏中读取授权请求的 redirect_uri 参数，并将其与 Casdoor 中的配置进行比较。

该表格适用于两种设置：内置于 Casdoor 的 MCP 服务器（位于 /api/mcp），以及使用 Casdoor 作为其授权服务器 的您自己的 MCP 服务器。在这两种情况下，客户端都通过受保护资源元数据 (RFC 9728) 找到 Casdoor，并从 Casdoor 获取其客户端 ID。

选项 1：允许客户端自行注册​

Casdoor 在 /api/oauth/register 支持动态客户端注册 (RFC 7591) 和客户端 ID 元数据文档 (CIMD)，其中 client_id 是一个列出客户端重定向 URI 的 JSON 文档的 HTTPS URL。一个开关控制这两项功能：组织上的 Enable dynamic client registration。它默认处于关闭状态，包括 built-in 在内的所有组织都是如此。

为 built-in 开启此开关后，发现文档将显示客户端所需的信息：

curl -s https://your-casdoor.com/.well-known/openid-configuration | jq '{
  registration_endpoint,
  client_id_metadata_document_supported,
  code_challenge_methods_supported,
  token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported,
  authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported
}'
{
  "registration_endpoint": "https://your-casdoor.com/api/oauth/register",
  "client_id_metadata_document_supported": true,
  "code_challenge_methods_supported": ["S256"],
  "token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported": ["client_secret_basic", "client_secret_post", "private_key_jwt", "none"],
  "authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported": true
}

然后每个客户端选择其方法：

  • Claude 仅在元数据同时包含 client_id_metadata_document_supported: true 和 token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported 中的 none 时才使用 CIMD。一旦开启开关，Casdoor 就具备这两个条件，因此 Claude 通过文档 URL 标识自身，并且 Casdoor 会创建一个名为 cimd_... 的应用。否则，Claude 回退到 DCR。
  • ChatGPT 优先使用 CIMD，其 client_id 为 https://chatgpt.com/oauth/client.json（或针对特定回调的变体），当 CIMD 不可用时则使用 DCR。
  • Cursor 通过 DCR 注册为公共客户端，无需密钥。Cursor 的文档未提及 CIMD。
  • mcp-remote 通过 DCR 注册。

重定向 URI 来自注册请求或元数据文档，因此无需手动输入。已注册的客户端在受限角色下运行，其令牌无法调用管理 API。有关完整规则以及客户端所属的组织，请参阅动态客户端注册。

选项 2：为客户端创建应用​

如果您保持注册功能关闭，请为每个客户端创建一个应用，以便您可以分别撤销它们：

  1. 在 Casdoor 管理控制台中，前往 Identity > Applications 并添加一个应用，例如 cursor-mcp。
  2. 将表格中客户端的重定向 URI 添加到 Redirect URLs。对于 Cursor，添加全部三个，因为不同的 Cursor 安装发送的 URI 不同。
  3. 将 Category 设置为 Agent。有关范围和授权类型，请参阅为您的 MCP 服务器设置 Casdoor。
  4. 将 Client ID 提供给客户端。

对于这些客户端，客户端密钥是可选的。如果请求使用了 PKCE，Casdoor 接受没有密钥的授权码交换，且 Cursor、Claude 和 ChatGPT 都使用带有 S256 的 PKCE。如果客户端确实发送了密钥，则必须是正确的密钥。

客户端 ID 的位置：

  • Cursor：~/.cursor/mcp.json 或 .cursor/mcp.json 中的 auth 对象。如果使用静态 CLIENT_ID，Cursor 桌面应用仅发送其 localhost 重定向 URI。

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "casdoor": {
          "url": "https://your-casdoor.com/api/mcp",
          "auth": {
            "CLIENT_ID": "${env:CASDOOR_MCP_CLIENT_ID}",
            "scopes": ["application:read", "user:read"]
          }
        }
      }
    }

  • Claude：自定义连接器对话框中的 OAuth 客户端 ID 字段。注册 https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback。

  • ChatGPT：ChatGPT 也支持预定义的 OAuth 客户端。从 ChatGPT 中 MCP 服务器的管理页面复制重定向 URI，因为它使用的两种形式之一取决于授权服务器。

分步指南：Cursor、Claude Desktop、ChatGPT。

Casdoor 如何匹配重定向 URI​

Casdoor 将请求的 redirect_uri 与 Redirect URLs 中的每个条目进行比较：

  • 方案、主机和路径必须匹配。不比较查询字符串。
  • 端口必须匹配，除非是环回主机。当两个 URI 都使用相同的环回主机（localhost、127.0.0.1 或 ::1）时，Casdoor 会忽略端口，正如 RFC 8252 对原生应用的要求那样。localhost 和 127.0.0.1 是不同的主机，因此 Claude Code 需要同时拥有 http://localhost/callback 和 http://127.0.0.1/callback。
  • 已注册主机的子域上的重定向 URI 也能匹配，因此 https://example.com/cb 接受 https://app.example.com/cb。请注册尽可能具体的主机。
  • 自定义方案（如 cursor://）遵循相同的匹配规则。javascript:、data: 和 vbscript: URI 始终被拒绝。

由于忽略了环回端口，当本地端口在会话之间变化时，mcp-remote 或 Claude Code 的注册仍然有效。

claude_desktop_config.json 的位置​

MCP 文档给出了这些路径。在 Claude Desktop 中，Settings > Developer > Edit Config 会打开该文件，如果文件不存在则创建它。

Operating systemPath
macOS~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
Windows%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
Linux~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json

Claude Desktop 通过两种方式之一访问远程 MCP 服务器，它们使用不同的重定向 URI：

  • 作为连接器，在 Claude 的连接器设置中添加。Anthropic 的服务器执行 OAuth 流程，重定向 URI 为 https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback，并且 Casdoor 必须可从互联网访问。

  • 通过 claude_desktop_config.json，使用 mcp-remote 作为本地桥接。OAuth 流程在您的计算机上运行，重定向 URI 为 http://localhost:<port>/oauth/callback：

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "casdoor": {
          "command": "npx",
          "args": ["mcp-remote", "https://your-casdoor.com/api/mcp"]
        }
      }
    }

编辑文件后，完全退出并重新启动 Claude Desktop。

托管客户端需要公开的 Casdoor​

ChatGPT 和 Claude 连接器从其供应商的服务器而非您的计算机调用您的 MCP 服务器和 Casdoor。Casdoor 必须可通过具有有效证书的公共 HTTPS 访问。如果您按 IP 过滤，Anthropic 的请求来自 160.79.104.0/21。Cursor 桌面版、Claude Code 和 mcp-remote 在本地运行流程，因此网络内的 Casdoor 即可满足需求。

托管客户端还会检查另外两点，而 Casdoor 已经做到了这一点：

  • 响应中的 Issuer (RFC 9207)：ChatGPT 会拒绝缺少正确 iss 的授权响应，并且仅对满足其 RFC 9207 要求的授权服务器使用其稳定的重定向 URI。Casdoor 在其元数据中声明支持该功能，并在重定向中添加 iss。
  • 资源指示器 (RFC 8707)：ChatGPT 在授权和令牌请求中发送带有 MCP 服务器 URL 的 resource。Casdoor 将该值放入访问令牌的 aud 声明中，您的 MCP 服务器应检查此值。有关发现流程，请参阅 MCP 身份验证。

www.casdoor.com 上的相关阅读：面向 AI 代理的 OAuth 和 面向 MCP 的授权服务器。

References​

  • Cursor: Model Context Protocol (MCP)，章节 "Static OAuth for remote servers"
  • Cursor 论坛: OAuth redirect URI changed from cursor:// to http://localhost
  • Anthropic: Authentication for connectors
  • Model Context Protocol: Connect to local MCP servers
  • OpenAI: Authenticate users
  • mcp-remote: README
  • Casdoor: 动态客户端注册, 为您的 MCP 服务器设置 Casdoor

item.title: Nginx CAS 认证与 SSO：使用 Casdoor 在 Nginx 后保护任意应用
item.description: 使用 Casdoor 在 Nginx 后的任意应用前添加 CAS、OIDC 或 auth_request 登录：对比转发认证、OAuth2 Proxy、nginx 模块、CAS 客户端和多因素认证 (MFA)。
item.content:encoded:
开源版 nginx 没有 CAS 模块，因此实际上“nginx CAS 认证”意味着两种配置之一。要么 nginx 通过其 auth_request 模块向每个请求询问认证服务，由 Casdoor 回答（直接通过 /api/forward-auth，或通过 casdoor-forward-auth 或 OAuth2 Proxy），要么 nginx 后面的应用本身是一个 CAS 客户端，并与 Casdoor 的 CAS 服务器端点通信。如果您可以重新构建 nginx，Casdoor nginx 模块会在 nginx 内部运行登录；如果您不想运行 nginx，Casdoor 的站点代理可以位于应用之前。在所有情况下，登录页面都是 Casdoor 的，因此一个 SSO 会话、一组权限和一个 MFA 策略覆盖所有应用。

选项概览​

选项登录逻辑运行位置Nginx 需要什么与 Casdoor 的协议谁可以进入何时选择它
Casdoor 转发认证Casdoor, /api/forward-authauth_request应用域名上的 Casdoor 会话 Cookie应用权限，至少每分钟再次检查Nginx 已经在前端，且您不想添加额外服务
casdoor-forward-auth一个小型 Go 服务auth_requestOIDC 授权码Casdoor 角色或组，按 location 区分多个子域名共享一个会话 Cookie
OAuth2 ProxyOAuth2 Proxyauth_requestOIDCallowed_groups, 电子邮件域您已经运行 OAuth2 Proxy
casdoor-nginx-modulenginx 本身一个编译好的模块带有 PKCE 的 OIDC，本地验证令牌该应用的任何已登录用户无需额外进程，并为 API 提供 Bearer 令牌
应用中的 CAS 客户端应用无，仅代理CAS 1.0, 2.0, 3.0应用如何处理属性应用已经支持 CAS
Casdoor 站点代理Casdoor 在端口 80 和 443无 NginxCasdoor 会话应用权限没有其他东西位于应用前端

前三个选项的区别仅在于谁回答 nginx 的子请求。

为什么没有“nginx CAS 模块”​

CAS 是应用程序与 CAS 服务器之间的对话：应用将浏览器发送到服务器的 /login 并附带 service URL，在该 URL 上获得服务票据，并通过服务器到服务器的调用验证票据。Apache httpd 有 Apereo 的 mod_auth_cas 来在 Web 服务器上执行此操作，但 nginx 的官方模块中没有 CAS 模块。对于 nginx，标准构建块是 ngx_http_auth_request_module：在提供服务之前，nginx 向您选择的 URL 发送子请求。2xx 响应允许请求通过，401 或 403 以该代码拒绝，其他代码视为错误。

对用户而言，CAS 登录和 OIDC 登录看起来相同：重定向到 Casdoor 登录页面再返回。因此，对于不支持 CAS 的应用，实际解决方案是在 nginx 层使用 OIDC。关于协议的背景信息：什么是 CAS。

auth_request 模块默认不构建：编译时添加 --with-http_auth_request_module，或在打包版的 nginx 上检查 nginx -V。

选项 1：Casdoor 自身的转发认证​

Casdoor 可以自行回答 nginx 的子请求。您在 Casdoor 中添加一个 Site，其 Domain 为应用的域名，其 Casdoor app 为用户登录的应用，并将 https://app.example.com/caswaf-handler 添加到该应用的 Redirect URLs。主机和端口可以留空，因为流量不经过 Casdoor。

由于 auth_request 无法跟随重定向，Casdoor 对未认证的子请求响应 401，并将登录 URL 放入 Location。nginx 将其转换为 302：

server {
    server_name app.example.com;

    proxy_buffer_size 16k;
    proxy_buffers 8 16k;

    location = /caswaf-handler {
        proxy_pass http://casdoor:8000/api/forward-auth;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Uri $request_uri;
    }

    location = /casdoor-auth {
        internal;
        proxy_pass http://casdoor:8000/api/forward-auth;
        proxy_pass_request_body off;
        proxy_set_header Content-Length "";
        proxy_set_header X-Original-URL $scheme://$http_host$request_uri;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Method $request_method;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    }

    location / {
        auth_request /casdoor-auth;
        auth_request_set $casdoor_redirect $upstream_http_location;
        auth_request_set $casdoor_user $upstream_http_x_forwarded_user;
        auth_request_set $casdoor_email $upstream_http_x_forwarded_email;
        auth_request_set $casdoor_groups $upstream_http_x_forwarded_groups;
        error_page 401 =302 $casdoor_redirect;

        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-User $casdoor_user;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Email $casdoor_email;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Groups $casdoor_groups;
        proxy_pass http://app:3000;
    }
}

后端在 X-Forwarded-User、X-Forwarded-Email 和 X-Forwarded-Groups 中接收用户。访问遵循应用上的权限，至少每分钟再次检查，因此被禁用的用户会迅速失去访问权限。站点的 Public paths（Webhooks，健康检查）无需登录即可通过。

有关参考信息，请参阅 使用您自己的反向代理，有关 Grafana 的分步指南，请参阅 在不使用 OIDC 的情况下为应用添加登录。该应用必须仅通过 nginx 访问，否则任何人都可以自己发送 X-Forwarded-User。

选项 2：casdoor-forward-auth 或 OAuth2 Proxy​

如果您不想为每个应用创建一个 Casdoor 站点，可以运行一个小型服务，针对 Casdoor 执行 OIDC 流程并响应子请求。

casdoor-forward-auth 是 Casdoor 为此提供的独立服务（它取代了 traefik-casdoor-auth）。它将用户保存在签名 Cookie 中，无需服务器状态。对于 nginx，它暴露 /verify 端点，返回带有身份标头的 200 状态码或 401 状态码，nginx 在收到 401 时重定向到其 /login：

server {
    server_name app.example.com;

    location = /_casdoor_verify {
        internal;
        proxy_pass http://casdoor-forward-auth:9999/verify?groups=built-in/dev;
        proxy_pass_request_body off;
        proxy_set_header Content-Length "";
    }

    location @casdoor_login {
        return 302 https://auth.example.com/login?rd=$scheme://$http_host$request_uri;
    }

    location / {
        auth_request /_casdoor_verify;
        error_page 401 = @casdoor_login;

        auth_request_set $casdoor_user $upstream_http_x_forwarded_user;
        auth_request_set $casdoor_roles $upstream_http_x_forwarded_roles;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-User $casdoor_user;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Roles $casdoor_roles;
        proxy_pass http://app:8080;
    }
}

验证 URL 上的 roles 和 groups 查询参数将每个应用限制为持有特定 Casdoor 角色或属于特定群组的用户；已登录但缺少这些权限的用户会收到 403 错误。角色和群组在登录时读取并在会话期间保留，因此更改会在用户重新登录后生效。设置 COOKIE_DOMAIN=example.com 可以让一次登录覆盖所有子域名。Traefik 指南 介绍了如何在 Traefik 中使用相同的服务。

OAuth2 Proxy 的工作原理类似，需将 provider = "oidc" 且 oidc_issuer_url 设置为您的 Casdoor URL。其 /oauth2/auth 端点返回 202 或 401，用户和电子邮件标头需要 --set-xauthrequest，并且其 nginx 示例中的转发标头处理需要 --reverse-proxy。有两个 Casdoor 设置很重要：使用 JWT-Standard 令牌格式，否则未验证邮箱的用户将被拒绝；保留 profile 范围以便返回群组和角色。请参阅 OAuth2 Proxy with Casdoor 和 nginx 社区版指南。

选项 3：Casdoor nginx 模块​

casdoor-nginx-module 在 nginx 内部处理登录，无需单独的进程。没有会话的浏览器会跳转到 Casdoor 的登录页面；模块使用 PKCE 交换代码，根据 Casdoor 证书验证访问令牌的签名、exp、aud 和类型，并将用户保存在签名 Cookie 中。API 客户端可以发送包含 Casdoor 访问令牌的 Authorization: Bearer，在本地进行验证而无需调用 Casdoor。

它需要 nginx 1.22 或更新版本以及 OpenSSL 1.1.1 或更新版本。您可以将其作为动态模块构建在您现有的 nginx 上：

./configure --with-compat --with-http_ssl_module --add-dynamic-module=/path/to/casdoor-nginx-module
make modules
cp objs/ngx_http_casdoor_module.so /etc/nginx/modules/
load_module modules/ngx_http_casdoor_module.so;

events {}

http {
    server {
        listen 443 ssl;
        server_name app.example.com;
        ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/app.crt;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/app.key;

        casdoor_endpoint        https://door.example.com;
        casdoor_client_id       <client-id>;
        casdoor_client_secret   <client-secret>;
        casdoor_certificate     /etc/nginx/casdoor.pem;
        casdoor_redirect_uri    https://app.example.com/casdoor/callback;
        casdoor_token_location  /_casdoor/token;

        location = /_casdoor/token {
            internal;
            proxy_pass https://door.example.com/api/login/oauth/access_token;
            proxy_ssl_server_name on;
        }

        location = /casdoor/callback {
            casdoor_callback;
        }

        location / {
            casdoor on;
            proxy_set_header X-User $casdoor_user;
            proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
        }
    }
}

将占位符替换为应用的值。在会话过期之前，不会再次向 Casdoor 检查会话，因此禁用用户在会话结束时生效；casdoor_session_timeout 可缩短该时间窗口。该模块没有角色或群组检查。在 NGINX Plus 上，请参阅 NGINX Plus 指南。

选项 4：应用是 CAS 客户端​

如果应用已经支持 CAS，例如使用 Apereo CAS 客户端的 Java 应用，nginx 仅充当代理，Casdoor 作为 CAS 服务器。每个 Casdoor 应用在 /cas/<organization>/<application> 下都有 CAS 端点：/login 和 /logout，用于 CAS 1.0 的 /validate，用于 2.0 的 /serviceValidate、/proxyValidate 和 /proxy，用于 3.0 的 /p3/serviceValidate 和 /p3/proxyValidate，以及用于 SAML 1.1 验证的 /samlValidate。

应用将浏览器发送到 /login?service=...，Casdoor 携带 ticket=ST-... 重定向回来，应用对其进行验证：

curl "https://door.example.com/cas/my-org/my-app/p3/serviceValidate?ticket=ST-1234567890&service=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.example.com%2F"

成功的响应是一个 cas:serviceResponse，其中包含 cas:user 以及电子邮件、显示名称和 memberOf 等属性；添加 format=json 以获取 JSON 格式。容易让人困惑的地方包括：

  • 每个 service URL 都必须列在应用的 Redirect URLs 中，并且在验证时的 service 必须与颁发票据时使用的完全一致。
  • 票据只能使用一次，并在 5 分钟后过期。
  • 票据保存在内存中，因此在有多个 Casdoor 副本的情况下，验证请求必须到达颁发票据的那个副本（粘性会话）。
  • 在 nginx 后面，传递 Host 和 X-Forwarded-Proto，以便应用构建与浏览器看到的相同的 service URL。

设置方法（包括针对不同 CAS 版本的 Java 客户端过滤器）请参见 连接 CAS 客户端。

选项 5：让 Casdoor 成为反向代理​

当应用前面没有其他组件时，Casdoor 可以直接提供服务：一旦存在站点，其站点代理将在 gatewayHttpPort 和 gatewayHttpsPort（默认为 80 和 443）上监听。将站点的 Host 设置为后端，选择证书，设置 Casdoor app，并将 DNS 指向 Casdoor。登录、权限和标头的行为与选项 1 相同。请参阅 Sites。

添加 MFA​

MFA 不需要对 nginx 或应用进行任何更改。Casdoor 在其自身的登录页面上在发出 OAuth 授权代码或 CAS 服务票据之前询问第二因素，因此上述每个选项都支持它。用户可以使用 TOTP 应用、短信、电子邮件或 RADIUS，并配有恢复代码，管理员可以通过 MFA 项目 要求组织启用 MFA。这也回答了“CAS 2FA”的问题：当 Casdoor 作为 CAS 服务器时，第二因素是 CAS 登录的一部分。

MFA 在登录时强制执行，而不是针对每个请求：nginx 或 forward-auth 服务已经持有的会话将持续到过期为止，组织的 MFA remember time 允许用户在受信任的设备上一段时间内跳过第二因素。请参阅 MFA 指南 和 什么是 MFA。

一旦登录到 Casdoor，用户即可访问其他将请求发送到 Casdoor 的应用，而无需新的密码提示；启用 Auto signin 后，Casdoor 还会跳过账户选择器。请参阅 单点登录 和 Single logout。

如何选择​

  • 应用中无登录功能且 nginx 已在前面：使用 Casdoor 的 forward auth。
  • 跨多个子域名的统一登录，或按位置进行角色检查：casdoor-forward-auth（如果你已经运行 OAuth2 Proxy，也可以使用它）。
  • 你自己构建 nginx 并使用 bearer 令牌保护 API：casdoor-nginx-module。
  • 应用支持 CAS：使用 Casdoor 的 CAS 端点，nginx 作为普通代理。
  • 尚无代理：使用 Casdoor 的网站代理。

参考资料​

  • nginx: ngx_http_auth_request_module
  • OAuth2 Proxy: nginx integration
  • Apereo: CAS Protocol Specification, mod_auth_cas
  • Casdoor: casdoor-forward-auth, casdoor-nginx-module
  • Casdoor docs: Sites, Connect a CAS client, MFA

item.title: RP-Initiated Logout and SSO Logout in OpenID Connect: How Casdoor Signs Users Out
item.description: How OIDC RP-initiated logout, back-channel logout and token revocation work in Casdoor, what each one clears, and how single sign-out spans several apps.
item.content:encoded:
Logging a user out of an OpenID Connect app takes more than deleting your own session cookie. The user is still signed in at the identity provider, so the next "Sign in" click goes straight through without a password, and the other apps that share that identity provider session stay signed in too. A proper logout has three parts: clear your app's local session, send the browser to the provider's end_session_endpoint (RP-initiated logout) so the provider session ends, and let the provider tell the other apps through back-channel logout. With Casdoor, the end-session endpoint is /api/logout, back-channel logout is configured per application, and refresh tokens can be revoked at /api/login/oauth/revoke.

Logout mechanisms at a glance​

MechanismWho triggers itWhat it clearsCasdoor support
Local app logoutYour appYour app's session cookie and stored tokens onlyYour code
RP-initiated logoutYour app, by redirecting the browserThe Casdoor browser session and the token of the id_token_hintYes, GET or POST /api/logout, announced as end_session_endpoint
Back-channel logoutCasdoor, server to serverThe sessions of other apps, each app ends its ownYes, per application Backchannel logout URL
Front-channel logoutThe provider, through hidden iframesThe sessions of other apps, through the browserNo, Casdoor doesn't announce frontchannel_logout_supported
Token revocation (RFC 7009)Your app, server or clientOne access or refresh token, and the tokens that share its refresh tokenYes, POST /api/login/oauth/revoke, announced as revocation_endpoint
Casdoor SSO logoutYour app, with the user's token or cookieAll sessions and tokens of the user, or the current session onlyYes, /api/sso-logout, Casdoor-specific
SAML single logoutCasdoor or a SAML service providerSessions in SAML appsYes, signed LogoutRequest

Local session vs. identity provider session​

There are at least two sessions involved in every OIDC sign-in, and often three:

  1. Your app's session. Usually a cookie that maps to the user and the tokens you got from the token endpoint.
  2. The Casdoor session. A cookie on the Casdoor domain. As long as it is valid, Casdoor signs the user in to any app of the organization without a password, after a one-click account picker or silently with automatic sign-in. That is what makes single sign-on work.
  3. An upstream identity provider session, when the user signed in to Casdoor through Google, GitHub, an enterprise IdP and so on.

Auth0 describes the same three layers in its logout documentation (application, Auth0 and identity provider session layers), and the model applies to any OIDC provider.

"Localized application session termination" ends only the first one: your app forgets the user, the Casdoor session lives on. That is what happens when you just clear a cookie. "Centralized single sign-out" ends the Casdoor session and tells every app of the user to end its own. Most users who click "Sign out" expect the second, especially on a shared computer.

For the third layer, Casdoor calls the logout URL of a Custom OAuth provider when the application signs users in through one and the provider has a logout URL set. It doesn't sign the user out of Google or GitHub.

RP-initiated logout with the end-session endpoint​

OpenID Connect RP-Initiated Logout 1.0 defines how a relying party (your app) asks the provider to end its session. The provider publishes the endpoint as end_session_endpoint in its discovery document, and the request carries these parameters:

  • id_token_hint: the ID token the provider issued to your app. The spec marks it RECOMMENDED. Casdoor uses it to find and expire that exact token.
  • post_logout_redirect_uri: where the browser goes afterwards. The spec requires it to be registered in advance. Casdoor checks it against the application's Redirect URLs and refuses to redirect to anything else.
  • state: an opaque value that Casdoor appends to the redirect, so your app can tell its own logout round trip from a forged one.
  • client_id: identifies the app when you can't send an ID token.

The spec also defines logout_hint and ui_locales. Casdoor doesn't read them.

Casdoor's discovery document at /.well-known/openid-configuration announces end_session_endpoint as https://<your-casdoor>/api/logout, so OIDC libraries that support RP-initiated logout pick it up without configuration. The endpoint accepts GET and POST, as the spec requires.

What Casdoor does with the request, briefly (the RP-initiated logout reference has every branch):

  • With id_token_hint, Casdoor looks up the token, sends back-channel logout tokens to the user's applications, expires the token (its refresh token stops working too), clears the browser's Casdoor session and redirects to post_logout_redirect_uri with state.
  • Without id_token_hint, Casdoor signs out the current browser session and expires the tokens issued in it. If the browser has no session left, it still redirects when it knows the app, from the session or from client_id.
  • Without post_logout_redirect_uri, the endpoint returns a JSON response instead of a redirect.

Example: sign-out button in a browser app​

A single-page app that signed in with the authorization code flow and PKCE keeps the ID token after the token exchange. The sign-out handler clears local state first, then hands the browser to Casdoor:

const ISSUER = "https://door.example.com";
const CLIENT_ID = "your-client-id";

async function signOut() {
  const idToken = sessionStorage.getItem("id_token");

  const discovery = await fetch(`${ISSUER}/.well-known/openid-configuration`)
    .then((r) => r.json());

  // 1. Forget the user locally, whatever happens next
  sessionStorage.clear();

  // 2. Remember a state value to check when Casdoor sends the browser back
  const state = crypto.randomUUID();
  sessionStorage.setItem("logout_state", state);

  // 3. End the Casdoor session
  const url = new URL(discovery.end_session_endpoint);
  if (idToken) {
    url.searchParams.set("id_token_hint", idToken);
  } else {
    url.searchParams.set("client_id", CLIENT_ID);
  }
  url.searchParams.set("post_logout_redirect_uri", "https://app.example.com/signed-out");
  url.searchParams.set("state", state);
  window.location.assign(url.toString());
}

// On https://app.example.com/signed-out
const returned = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("state");
if (returned !== sessionStorage.getItem("logout_state")) {
  console.warn("Unexpected logout redirect");
}
sessionStorage.removeItem("logout_state");

Add https://app.example.com/signed-out to the application's Redirect URLs in Casdoor, or Casdoor returns an error instead of redirecting. A server-rendered app does the same from its logout route: destroy the server session, then answer with a 302 to the end-session URL. For Spring Security, see the Spring Boot SSO post.

Back-channel logout: telling the other apps​

Ending the Casdoor session stops new silent sign-ins, but app B still has its own session cookie from an hour ago. Something has to tell app B. OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout 1.0 does this server to server: the provider sends a POST with a form parameter logout_token, a signed JWT that names the user, to each app's registered back-channel URI.

In Casdoor, set Backchannel logout URL on the application's edit page. When a user signs out through /api/logout, Casdoor sends a logout token to every application that holds an active token for that user and has this URL set. The token is signed with the application's certificate, the same key as its ID tokens, and contains:

  • iss and aud: the same issuer and client ID as the app's ID tokens
  • sub: the user's ID, the same value as sub in the ID token
  • iat and jti
  • events with the member http://schemas.openid.net/event/backchannel-logout
  • sid only for some logouts, such as SSO logout, and not for /api/logout

Casdoor's ID tokens don't carry a sid claim, so key your local sessions by sub and end all of them for that user. Casdoor's logout token also has no exp claim, which the final spec lists as required, so check freshness with iat and don't make exp mandatory in your validator. Casdoor sends each token once, with a 30-second timeout, and doesn't retry. For applications outside the built-in organization, it refuses to call loopback and link-local addresses, so http://localhost won't receive logout tokens during development.

Example: a back-channel logout receiver​

This Express handler follows the validation steps of the spec, using the jose library:

import express from "express";
import { createRemoteJWKSet, jwtVerify } from "jose";

// Take both values from the discovery document of your Casdoor
const ISSUER = "https://door.example.com";
const JWKS = createRemoteJWKSet(new URL(`${ISSUER}/.well-known/jwks`));
const CLIENT_ID = process.env.CASDOOR_CLIENT_ID;
const EVENT = "http://schemas.openid.net/event/backchannel-logout";

const seenJti = new Map();
const app = express();

app.post(
  "/oidc/backchannel-logout",
  express.urlencoded({ extended: false }),
  async (req, res) => {
    res.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
    try {
      const { payload } = await jwtVerify(req.body.logout_token, JWKS, {
        issuer: ISSUER,
        audience: CLIENT_ID,
        maxTokenAge: "2m",
      });

      if (!payload.events || typeof payload.events[EVENT] !== "object") {
        throw new Error("not a logout token");
      }
      if (!payload.sub && !payload.sid) {
        throw new Error("no sub or sid");
      }
      if ("nonce" in payload) {
        throw new Error("nonce is not allowed");
      }
      if (seenJti.has(payload.jti)) {
        throw new Error("replayed token");
      }
      seenJti.set(payload.jti, Date.now());

      // Your own helper: delete every session row that belongs to this user
      await destroySessionsForUser(payload.sub);
      res.sendStatus(200);
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "invalid_request", error_description: err.message });
    }
  }
);

jwtVerify checks the signature, iss, aud, and with maxTokenAge the iat claim. To find sessions by user, store sub from the ID token in each session record at sign-in. Prune seenJti periodically, or keep it in Redis.

Revoking refresh tokens​

A refresh token outlives the session that created it. If your app keeps one, a logout that never touches it leaves a credential that can mint new access tokens for days.

The end-session call with id_token_hint already expires that token, refresh token included. Revoke explicitly when the logout doesn't go through the browser, for example in a CLI, a desktop or mobile app, or when the user leaves only your app and keeps the Casdoor session. Casdoor implements RFC 7009 at the revocation_endpoint of its discovery document:

curl -X POST https://door.example.com/api/login/oauth/revoke \
  -u "$CLIENT_ID:$CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -d token="$REFRESH_TOKEN" \
  -d token_type_hint=refresh_token

A public client that used PKCE can send client_id in the body without a secret. Revoking a refresh token also expires the access tokens issued with it. After that, the refresh endpoint answers invalid_grant and introspection returns "active": false; When Casdoor revokes tokens lists every event that does this.

One limit applies to every provider that issues JWT access tokens: an API that only checks the signature and exp keeps accepting a revoked access token until it expires. Keep access tokens short-lived, or have the API call token introspection when it must notice a logout at once.

Single sign-out across several apps​

With the pieces above, single sign-out works like this when the user clicks "Sign out" in app A:

  1. App A clears its session and redirects to /api/logout with id_token_hint.
  2. Casdoor sends logout tokens to the back-channel URLs of the user's other apps, expires the token, and ends the browser's Casdoor session.
  3. Apps B and C receive the logout token and delete their sessions for that sub.
  4. The browser lands on app A's signed-out page. Opening app B now shows the Casdoor sign-in page.

An app without a back-channel URL stays signed in until its own session or access token expires. If you can't add a receiver to an app, keep its sessions short or make it validate the token on each request.

For "sign me out everywhere" after a lost laptop, use Casdoor's SSO logout endpoint with logoutAll=true: it expires every token and deletes every session of the user, and also sends signed notifications through notification providers to apps that don't speak OIDC. Administrators can end single sessions on the Sessions page. For SAML apps, see SAML single logout. Background reading: single logout and SAML single logout on www.casdoor.com.

item.title: RADIUS Multi-Factor Authentication for VPN and Wi-Fi: TOTP 2FA with the Casdoor RADIUS Server
item.description: Add TOTP 2FA to VPN logins over RADIUS with Casdoor: why only PAP works, how Access-Challenge asks for the code, which VPN clients support it, and Wi-Fi limits.
item.content:encoded:
To put multi-factor authentication in front of a VPN with RADIUS, the VPN gateway sends the username and password to the RADIUS server with PAP, the server checks the password and answers with an Access-Challenge, the client shows a prompt, and the user types the 2FA code from an authenticator app into a second request. Casdoor ships a RADIUS server that does exactly this for users who have TOTP set up, so a gateway that can show an Access-Challenge prompt (FortiGate SSL VPN is one whose vendor documents it) gets a password plus a 2FA code without any extra software. Wi-Fi with WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise is different: 802.1X runs over EAP, which has no place for a typed code, so Casdoor has a switch to skip the code for those clients.

If you want the background on RADIUS itself and how it compares with LDAP for network devices, read RADIUS vs LDAP first. This post is about the MFA part: what goes over the wire, which clients can carry a second factor, and how to turn it on in Casdoor.

Which clients can do RADIUS MFA with Casdoor​

The table lists what each vendor documents. "Challenge support" means the client shows the Access-Challenge prompt to the user and sends the answer back. Where the vendor page we checked doesn't say, the table says so instead of guessing.

ClientRADIUS auth method to use with CasdoorAccess-Challenge supportNotes
FortiGate SSL VPNPAP (set the method to PAP, or leave Default, which tries PAP first)Yes, per FortinetFortinet says SSL VPN forwards the challenge to the client and waits for the answer
FortiGate IPsec VPN (including FortiClient)PAPNot forwarded by defaultFortinet's fix requires MS-CHAP on the RADIUS server, which Casdoor doesn't speak; use SSL VPN or skip MFA
Cisco ASA (AnyConnect / Secure Client)PAP, the ASA default for all connection typesNot stated in the ASA RADIUS configuration guideDon't enable password-management on the tunnel group: it switches the ASA to MS-CHAPv2
OpenVPN Access ServerPAP (it also offers CHAP and MS-CHAPv2)Not stated on the RADIUS settings pageAccounting is a separate toggle, default port 1813
pfSense (RADIUS auth server, used by its OpenVPN)PAP (also MD5-CHAP, MS-CHAPv1, MS-CHAPv2)Not stated in the Netgate docsNetgate's OTP examples put the code inside the password field, which Casdoor doesn't accept
WireGuardNoneNot applicablePeers authenticate with public keys only, so there is no login for RADIUS to check
Wi-Fi, WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X)EAP (PEAP, EAP-TTLS and so on)No typed-code promptCasdoor doesn't implement EAP; see the Wi-Fi section

Where a cell says "not stated", test with the real VPN client before you roll it out, and check that the prompt appears and the code goes through.

Why only PAP can carry the password Casdoor checks​

RADIUS has several ways to send a password, and they decide what the server is able to verify.

With PAP, the client puts the password into the User-Password attribute, hidden with an MD5 hash of the shared secret and the request authenticator (RFC 2865, section 5.2). The server reverses that with the same secret, gets the cleartext password, and can check it against a stored hash or an LDAP bind. Casdoor reads User-Password and runs the same password check as its sign-in page.

With CHAP, the client never sends the password. It sends a hash of the password and a random challenge. RFC 2865 says plainly that CHAP needs the user's password in cleartext on the server to recompute that hash. MS-CHAPv2 has the same shape with an NT hash. An identity provider that stores passwords as one-way hashes (Casdoor's built-in organization uses bcrypt) can't verify either one. The Casdoor RADIUS server only reads User-Password, so a CHAP or MS-CHAPv2 request reaches it with no password and is rejected.

Because the PAP hiding is only MD5 with the shared secret, use a long random secret, keep RADIUS on a private network or a VPN between the gateway and Casdoor, and turn on the Message-Authenticator attribute on the client. Casdoor verifies Message-Authenticator when a request carries it and signs its reply in that case, which is the mitigation for Blast-RADIUS (CVE-2024-3596). The details are in the RADIUS server docs.

Access-Challenge vs appending the code to the password​

There are two common ways to get a 2FA code through RADIUS.

  1. Access-Challenge. The server checks the password, then replies with Access-Challenge, a State attribute and a Reply-Message. The client shows the message, the user types the code, and the client sends a new Access-Request with the code in User-Password and the same State. RFC 2865 section 4.4 also says what happens on a client without challenge support: it MUST treat the Access-Challenge as an Access-Reject.
  2. Code appended to the password. The user types password123456 into the one password field, and the server splits off the last six digits. This works with any client, which is why products built for older gateways offer it.

Casdoor implements only the first. Here is the flow in its RADIUS server (radius/server.go):

  • The first Access-Request must carry the correct password. A user with MFA turned on gets Access-Challenge, a random State, and the Reply-Message please enter OTP.
  • The State is valid for 120 seconds and can be used once. It is tied to the organization and username of the first request.
  • The second Access-Request must carry that State and the six-digit TOTP code from the user's authenticator app in User-Password. Casdoor checks the code against the user's TOTP secret and answers Access-Accept or Access-Reject.
  • Wrong codes count toward the failed sign-in limit of the user's application (5 attempts and a 15-minute freeze by default), separately from wrong passwords.

Two consequences follow. A client that can only do "password plus code in one field" will fail, because Casdoor checks the whole string as the password. And only TOTP works over RADIUS: SMS and email codes need Casdoor to send a message after the password step, which the RADIUS server doesn't do. A user whose only MFA method is SMS or email gets the challenge and then a reject, so have RADIUS users set up an authenticator app.

Wi-Fi: 802.1X and WPA-Enterprise​

On Wi-Fi with WPA2-Enterprise or WPA3-Enterprise, the access point doesn't collect a password itself. It relays an EAP conversation between the device (the supplicant) and the RADIUS server, and RADIUS carries the EAP packets in EAP-Message attributes. In that setup Access-Challenge is already in use: every round trip of the EAP exchange is an Access-Request and Access-Challenge pair (RFC 3579). RFC 3579 also says a message carrying EAP-Message must not include Reply-Message, so there is no field for "please enter OTP" and no dialog on the phone or laptop to type a code into.

Two practical points for Casdoor:

  • Casdoor's RADIUS server doesn't implement EAP. An access point can't talk to it directly for WPA-Enterprise. You need an EAP server in front that terminates the TLS tunnel and forwards a plain PAP request. FreeRADIUS can do this with EAP-TTLS and PAP as the inner method, proxying the inner request to another RADIUS server, and the devices must be set to TTLS with PAP inside. PEAP with MS-CHAPv2, the default on many devices, won't work against Casdoor for the reason in the PAP section.
  • For those users, turn on Skip MFA for RADIUS on the organization. Casdoor then accepts users who have MFA after the password check alone. MFA on the web sign-in page is not affected.

Ports, shared secret and accounting​

RFC 2865 assigns UDP port 1812 to RADIUS authentication, and RFC 2866 assigns 1813 to accounting. Casdoor listens on one UDP port, radiusServerPort, and handles both Access-Request and Accounting-Request there. So point the gateway's accounting at the same port as authentication (1812 by default), not at 1813, or accounting packets will go nowhere. If Casdoor runs in a container, publish the port as UDP, for example -p 1812:1812/udp.

The shared secret is one value for all clients, radiusSecret. Every gateway that talks to Casdoor uses it.

For accounting, Casdoor records Start, Interim-Update and Stop messages in its database (table radius_accounting), with the session ID, session time, NAS address, framed IP and byte and packet counters. It only does that for organizations with RADIUS turned on.

配置 Casdoor​

1. Set the RADIUS options. In conf/app.conf, or as environment variables with the same names:

radiusServerPort = 1812
radiusDefaultOrganization = "my-company"
radiusSecret = "a-long-random-string-shared-with-the-gateway"

radiusDefaultOrganization is the organization Casdoor uses when a request has no Class attribute. If your gateway can't add a Class attribute to its requests, this setting decides which organization's users sign in over RADIUS. All keys are listed in the configuration reference.

2. Turn on RADIUS for the organization. On the organization edit page, turn on Enable RADIUS. It is off by default and only global administrators can change it. While it is off, Casdoor rejects every Access-Request for that organization and ignores its accounting.

3. Decide on MFA for RADIUS. Leave Skip MFA for RADIUS off for VPN gateways that support Access-Challenge. Turn it on for an organization whose RADIUS clients can't answer a challenge, such as WPA-Enterprise Wi-Fi.

4. Get users onto TOTP. Users set up an authenticator app from their profile page, as described in multi-factor authentication. To make it mandatory, add the TOTP item with the Required rule under the organization's MFA items. Note the order: a user who must still set up required MFA, or must change the password first, is rejected over RADIUS until they finish that on the Casdoor sign-in page.

5. Test from the command line. FreeRADIUS's radclient sends PAP requests and prints the reply:

echo 'User-Name = "alice", User-Password = "her-password"' \
  | radclient -x casdoor.example.com:1812 auth a-long-random-string-shared-with-the-gateway

For a user with TOTP you should see Access-Challenge with a State and the Reply-Message. Send the code back with that State within 120 seconds:

echo 'User-Name = "alice", User-Password = "123456", State = 0x...' \
  | radclient -x casdoor.example.com:1812 auth a-long-random-string-shared-with-the-gateway

Paste the State value from the first reply in place of 0x.... An Access-Accept means the setup is right, and the gateway is next.

If you also want Casdoor to use an outside RADIUS server as a second factor for its own web sign-in, that is the opposite direction and is covered by the RADIUS MFA provider.
